title: Dan Meuser discusses energy policy and congressional efforts during Pennsylvania events
text:
← Back to the wire
Dan Meuser discusses energy policy and congressional efforts during Pennsylvania events
Congressman Dan Meuser used social media posts on September 24-25, 2026 to highlight his participation in energy discussions with state officials and upcoming interviews about federal legislative work.
Congressman Dan Meuser, who represents Pennsylvania’s 9th district in the U.S. Congress, posted a series of updates on social media regarding recent discussions and media appearances focused on energy policy and legislative priorities.
On September 24, 2026, Meuser wrote: "Today, Energy @SecretaryWright joined @RepMackenzie, @SenatorJColeman, and I in Pennsylvania for a roundtable discussion on rising electricity demand, grid reliability, customer affordability, and what Pennsylvania needs to support economic development. After our discussion with https://t.co/QJayk1VA8l".
The following day, he announced his participation in local media interviews. On September 25, 2026, Meuser stated: "I’ll be joining the Bob Cordaro Show today at 11:05 AM to discuss Energy Secretary Chris Wright’s visit to Pennsylvania, our efforts in Congress to fight taxpayer fraud, and more. Make sure to tune in to WILK: https://t.co/iOYGWCzEGg https://t.co/odeAyzN675".
Later that same day, he added: "I’ll be joining National Report at 11:35 AM for an update on the biggest developments in Washington and Pennsylvania. Make sure to tune in to @NEWSMAX. https://t.co/Y53rq9zXs4".
Dan Meuser has served as a member of the U.S. House of Representatives since 2019 after succeeding Lou Barletta as the representative for Pennsylvania’s 9th district. Born in Babylon, New York, in 1964 and currently residing in Dallas, Meuser holds a BA from State University of New York Maritime College and Cornell University (FACTS 1-4).
